# beneficiary of deception

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:roleBeneficiaryOfDeception`](gmeow-roleBeneficiaryOfDeception.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/roleBeneficiaryOfDeception>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

An entity that benefits from a deception event, whether or not they are the deceiver — the third-party beneficiary who gains from the false belief induced in the deceived party.
